title: TSMC Plans Additional Wafer Price Increases Amid Tight 2 Nanometer Capacity
key_facts: TSMC is reportedly preparing another price rise of 3% to 6% on advanced wafers for Q1 2027, after earlier rises of 10% to 20%.
Higher electricity and production overhead costs are cited as drivers.
Orders for the 2 nanometer node reportedly exceeded expectations; TSMC lifted order targets by 15% to 20%.
Five fabs across Hsinchu Baoshan and Kaohsiung are said to be in full operation.
Qualcomm and AMD are reportedly considering Samsung as a second foundry; Samsung aims for yields above 70% on its SF2P process.
quote_evidence: TSMC is preparing another price increase of 3% to 6% on advanced wafer manufacturing for the first quarter of 2027.
News outlet digitimes reports that orders for the 2 nanometer node have jumped well beyond initial expectations.
why_it_matters_hint: Chip designers face rising costs and limited supply from the leading foundry, pushing some toward Samsung.
notes: Single-outlet report relaying DigiTimes; TSMC confirmation not stated. DigiTimes original not opened.
